editor.title: Card title
editor.title_helper: Optional title displayed at the top of the card.
editor.weather_entity_helper: Leave empty to auto-detect the best weather entity.
editor.mapping_helper: For every outdoor station metric, this tab shows exactly which entity/attribute is currently used and lets you type any entity id to override it manually. A manual override always wins over automatic detection. Start typing to see compatible entities, then clear the field to go back to automatic detection.
editor.image_url_helper: Use a /local/… path (files in config/www) or an HTTPS URL. The image must contain a transparent sky (alpha channel).
editor.min_height_helper: Minimum height of the animated scene viewport only (sky/house/precipitation). The information area below always grows naturally with its content and is never clipped.
editor.aspect_ratio_helper: Optional aspect ratio applied to the scene viewport only (e.g. 16/9). Leave empty to only use the minimum height.
editor.metrics_helper: Choose which station metrics are visible, their order, label, color and icon. To change which entity feeds a metric, use the "Entity mapping" tab.
editor.auto_configure_confirm: Auto-configure will save the automatically detected weather entity and sensors into this card's configuration. Continue?
editor.environment_helper: Add unlimited indoor and/or outdoor zones (rooms, garage, garden…) with manually mapped entities. Zone assignment is always manual and reliable — there is no automatic guessing of which room a sensor belongs to.
editor.remove_zone_confirm: Remove this environment zone? This cannot be undone.
editor.alerts_helper: Build visual recommendation rules (e.g. "Open the windows") from one or more numeric conditions. These are display-only: they are only evaluated while this card is open in your browser, and never call Home Assistant services, automations or notifications.
editor.alerts_example: Example: name "Open windows", conditions indoor CO₂ greater than 1000 ppm AND outdoor air quality index less than 50 AND outdoor temperature between 12 and 28.
editor.remove_alert_confirm: Remove this recommendation rule? This cannot be undone.
